text:
[RTIM.8.3.1] Tests are a separate file type, not a gated
capability, so a production build does not have to
refuse anything: a bundle carries no scenarios
unless the modules it compiles have tests
([LTSL.2.4], [LTES.7.6]), and `strip-tests` removes
them ([RCLI.1.6]).

A runtime that meets those atoms anyway skips them
rather than refusing the bundle ([RDSC.9.4]).

---
